components.name: Primary Action Button
components.description: Triggers format-preserving --fix preview and applies JSON edits.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #10B981; color: #0B0E14; font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 600; padding: 6px 12px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid #10B981; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #34D399; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #F4F6F8; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Workbench Button
components.description: Used for Copy YAML, Reset Fixture, and filter actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #171E2B; color: #F4F6F8; font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 500; padding: 6px 12px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid #263042; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 150ms, background 150ms; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #1E293B; border-color: #3B4A63; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #F4F6F8; outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview: i18n-ast-lint is an Operate-mode static-analysis instrument built for working engineers. Its visual language rejects the ornamental habits of AI-generated developer landing pages—no purple-to-cyan gradients, no glowing status dots, no decorative eyebrow pills above headings, no bento mosaics, and no fake traffic-light terminal costumes.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Signal Emerald (#10B981) appears only on the primary --fix action button, active tab indicator bar, and clean exit-code 0 states.

rules.name: The Monospace Discipline Rule
rules.body: Use JetBrains Mono strictly for source code, translation key IDs, file paths, line/column coordinates, exit codes, and CLI commands.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: All panels sit flat on the Obsidian Canvas (#0B0E14) separated by 1px solid #263042.

dos: Do lead immediately with the working AST editor and live diagnostic ledger in the first viewport.
Do verify every foreground/background text pairing at >= 4.5:1 contrast.
Do pair every diagnostic color cue with an explicit monospace type code, locale badge, and file:line:col coordinate.
Do provide a Reset Fixture action so evaluators who apply --fix or edit code can restore the preset in one click.
donts: Don't place an eyebrow pill badge, pulsing status dot, or gradient headline above the workbench title.
Don't use decorative emoji anywhere in headings, buttons, or diagnostic messages.
Don't use thick colored border-left stripes on cards or diagnostic rows.
Don't fabricate download counts, customer logos, or unmeasured latency numbers.
